input.rationale: Article VIX provides the Licensed Technology wholly "AS IS" and disclaims all warranties "WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED", expressly negating any warranty that the software is error-free, meets Licensee's requirements, or that nonconformities to the Documentation will be corrected. No affirmative performance or conformance warranty survives anywhere in the Agreement: the only related obligation is a "commercially reasonable efforts" Error Correction covenant (p0093), which is itself undercut by the disclaimer and carries no repair/replace/refund remedy. That is the playbook's walk-away position (AS IS with no conformance warranty), so it fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). Redline carves express warranties out of the disclaimer and adds a documentation-conformance warranty with repair, replace or refund, plus workmanlike performance, legal compliance and no-malicious-code; a 90-day/30-day period is available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer and add a 12-month conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy, plus workmanlike-performance, legal-compliance and no-malicious-code warranties.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, so we have no conformance warranty or remedy at all. We have added a standard performance warranty (documentation conformance for twelve months, professional and workmanlike support, compliance with law, no malicious code) with a repair, replace or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can discuss a 90-day software / 30-day services period as a fallback.
